script_content = '''import pymupdf
from docx import Document
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
import sys

def docx_to_pdf(docx_path, pdf_path):
    doc = Document(docx_path)
    
    # Create a new PDF document
    pdf = pymupdf.open()
    
    # Page dimensions (A4)
    page_width = 595.28
    page_height = 841.89
    margin_left = 72
    margin_right = 72
    margin_top = 72
    margin_bottom = 72
    usable_width = page_width - margin_left - margin_right
    
    # Create first page
    page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
    y_pos = margin_top
    
    for para in doc.paragraphs:
        text = para.text.strip()
        if not text:
            y_pos += 8  # blank line spacing
            if y_pos > page_height - margin_bottom:
                page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
                y_pos = margin_top
            continue
        
        # Determine font size and style based on paragraph style
        style_name = para.style.name.lower() if para.style else ""
        if "title" in style_name or "heading 1" in style_name:
            fontsize = 18
            fontname = "helv"
            bold = True
        elif "heading 2" in style_name:
            fontsize = 15
            fontname = "helv"
            bold = True
        elif "heading" in style_name:
            fontsize = 13
            fontname = "helv"
            bold = True
        else:
            fontsize = 10
            fontname = "helv"
            bold = False
        
        # Check if any run in the paragraph is bold
        if not bold:
            for run in para.runs:
                if run.bold:
                    bold = True
                    break
        
        # Simple word wrapping
        words = text.split()
        lines = []
        current_line = ""
        for word in words:
            test_line = current_line + (" " if current_line else "") + word
            # Approximate character width
            char_width = fontsize * 0.5
            if len(test_line) * char_width > usable_width:
                if current_line:
                    lines.append(current_line)
                current_line = word
            else:
                current_line = test_line
        if current_line:
            lines.append(current_line)
        
        line_height = fontsize * 1.4
        
        for line in lines:
            if y_pos + line_height > page_height - margin_bottom:
                page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
                y_pos = margin_top
            
            # Insert text
            text_point = pymupdf.Point(margin_left, y_pos)
            fn = "hebo" if bold else "helv"
            page.insert_text(text_point, line, fontsize=fontsize, fontname=fn)
            y_pos += line_height
        
        # Add paragraph spacing
        y_pos += fontsize * 0.4
    
    pdf.save(pdf_path)
    pdf.close()
    print(f"Successfully converted {docx_path} to {pdf_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    docx_to_pdf(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])
'''

import os
import sys
import fire
import shutil
import subprocess

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), ".."))
from _log import log_tool_call


def _convert_to_pdf(word_file_path, pdf_file_path):
    try:
        output_dir = os.path.dirname(pdf_file_path)
        os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
        lo_bin = shutil.which("libreoffice") or shutil.which("soffice")
        if lo_bin:
            subprocess.call([lo_bin, "--headless", "--convert-to", "pdf", word_file_path, "--outdir", output_dir])
            stem = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(word_file_path))[0]
            generated = os.path.join(output_dir, stem + ".pdf")
            if generated != pdf_file_path and os.path.exists(generated):
                os.rename(generated, pdf_file_path)
            if os.path.exists(pdf_file_path):
                return True
        from docx import Document
        from fpdf import FPDF
        doc = Document(word_file_path)
        pdf = FPDF()
        pdf.set_margins(15, 15, 15)
        pdf.add_page()
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", size=11)
        for para in doc.paragraphs:
            text = para.text.strip()
            if text:
                safe = text.encode("latin-1", errors="replace").decode("latin-1")
                pdf.multi_cell(0, 8, safe)
                pdf.ln(2)
        pdf.output(pdf_file_path)
        return os.path.exists(pdf_file_path)
    except Exception:
        return False


@log_tool_call("word.convert_to_pdf")
def main(word_file_path, pdf_file_path):
    if not os.path.exists(word_file_path):
        return f"OBSERVATION: The word file {word_file_path} does not exist. Failed to convert the file to pdf."
    success = _convert_to_pdf(word_file_path, pdf_file_path)
    if success:
        return f"OBSERVATION: Successfully convert {word_file_path} to {pdf_file_path}"
    return f"OBSERVATION: Failed to convert {word_file_path} to {pdf_file_path}"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    fire.Fire(main)
